fields.description: Fields to include (required by the API for this resource, e.g. "comments(id,content,author,resolved),nextPageToken")

fileId.description: The file to list comments for

includeDeleted.description: Whether to include deleted comments (they have no content)

pageToken.description: Page token from a previous call

startModifiedTime.description: Only return comments modified at or after this time (RFC 3339)
